items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Because I know Harry Miller and all them confidence men were right there.

ctx.x: Oh, well, for instance you'd close at 12:00 o'clock now, then you could go on down to the after-hour spots, and stay until -- hours. Then you got ready to go home, sometimes 9:00, 10:00 o'clock, later than that. As long as you wanted to. They didn't close. No, they didn't close. And nobody bothered anybody. Nobody would take a dime from anybody. And Chicago was full of sporting women and confidence men. Because I know Harry Miller and all them confidence men were right there. And those sporting girls. But they…
And people -- for instance, if you'd lose something, you'd lose $100.00 or something, they'd see you drop it, they'd say, 'hey, fellow, you dropped this money.'
